name: Axelar
notes: Cross-chain bridge, predominantly Cosmos/IBC based with a custom validator network; TVL tracked via Axelarscan, not an EVM subgraph. No public The Graph/Ponder-style indexer repo found.

name: Extended
notes: Starknet-based perps DEX (x10xchange org). Off-chain orderbook with Starknet settlement; org has SDKs and Cairo contracts but no public subgraph/indexer repo.

name: Lagoon
notes: hopperlabsxyz org has lagoon-v0 contracts, SDK, MCP and vault-computation-cli but no public subgraph/indexer repo in the org. Docs reference 'Vault Subgraphs' but the integration page is 403 and no repo is published; data appears served via SDK/CLI, not an open indexer.

name: exSat Staking BTC
notes: Bitcoin staking/bridge (EOS-VM/exSat). Custodial BTC staking, not EVM; no public subgraph/indexer.

name: CoinDCX
notes: Centralized exchange. TVL is custodial wallet balances; no on-chain protocol to index.

name: Sanctum Infinity
notes: Solana-only LST liquidity pool. Non-EVM; indexed via Solana-specific tooling, no EVM-style subgraph/indexer repo.

name: Telos Consilium
notes: Risk curator deploying capital into existing lending markets (Plasma/Ethereum). Curator entity, not its own indexable protocol; no public indexer repo found.

name: Kamino Liquidity
notes: Solana-only concentrated liquidity manager. Non-EVM; no public EVM-style subgraph/indexer repo.

name: Dolomite

repos.scope: Full protocol: Dolomite Margin contracts, markets, lending/margin positions, liquidations, USD/historical stats across all deployed chains
repos.verified: WebFetched repo page: contains schema.graphql + subgraph.template.yaml, 453 commits, 100% TypeScript, explicitly tracks Dolomite Margin contract state, markets, liquidations, vaporizations, account health. Official org repo.

notes: Official subgraph maintained by dolomite-exchange. Per docs.dolomite.io subgraphs are published per-chain (Arbitrum, Berachain, etc.). Forked originally from Uniswap subgraph.

name: Clearstar
notes: Risk curator (ClearstarLabs) allocating into lending markets across many chains. Curator entity, no own protocol contracts to index; no public indexer repo found.

name: Sky Money
notes: This DefiLlama entry is Sky's curated vaults (third-party Morpho strategies facilitated via sky.money). sky-ecosystem org has no subgraph repo (search returned 0). Community Maker MCD subgraph (protofire/maker-protocol-subgraph) exists but indexes legacy MCD CDPs, not the Sky-curated Morpho vaults; not a match for this specific entry.

name: Biconomy.com
notes: Centralized exchange (note: distinct from Biconomy AA infra). Custodial balances; no on-chain protocol to index.

name: GAIB
notes: AID/sAID AI-compute RWA synthetic dollar (LayerZero OFT tokens on ETH/Arbitrum/Base/BNB). gaib-ai org has only DefiLlama adapter forks and tooling; no public subgraph/indexer repo.

name: EtherFi Cash Liquid
notes: ether.fi Cash product (cash-v3 / cash-contracts on Optimism/Scroll). etherfi-protocol org has contracts but no public subgraph/indexer repo (searched org listing). Search claim of a 'deployed subgraph' was unsubstantiated by any repo.

name: Aerodrome V1

repos.scope: Aerodrome (Base, chain 8453) + Velodrome V2 (Optimism): pools, gauges, voting/veNFT, swaps, liquidity
repos.verified: WebFetched repo page: README states 'multi-chain blockchain indexer for Velodrome V2 (Optimism) and Aerodrome (Base)'; Base chain 8453 in supported networks; Envio HyperIndex (config.yaml). Official velodrome-finance org repo also used by Aerodrome (shared codebase).

notes: Indexed via the official Envio indexer at velodrome-finance/indexer (Velodrome and Aerodrome share the same team/codebase). No separate The Graph subgraph in the aerodrome-finance org (only contracts, slipstream, sugar on-chain API). Envio docs also document an Aerodrome DEX indexer example.
